7.3.9 Handling of unexpected N-PDU arrival
The behavior of the CAN Transport Layer on unexpected N-PDU arrival is greatly de-
pendent on the communication direction type of the processing N-SDU.
[SWS_CanTp_00057]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Can_01082
⌈If unexpected frames are received, the CanTp module shall behave according to the
table below. This table specifies the N-PDU handling considering the current CanTp
internal status (CanTp status).⌋
It must be understood, that the received N-PDU contains the same address information
(N_AI) as the reception or transmission, which may be in progress at the time the N_
PDU is received.
